ORDINANCE LIII OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN SEA
FISHERIES (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Balochistan
Sea Fisheries
Ordinance, 1971
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
28th December, 2001]
No. Legis. 1-9/Law/70, dated
28-12-2001.----The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
12th December, 2001 is hereby published for general information:
----
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Sea
Fisheries (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force on
the 14th day of August; 2001.

Amendment of section 9-A of Ordinance IX of 1971

2. Amendment of section 9‑A
of Ordinance IX of 1971.‑‑‑In the Balochistan Sea
Fisheries Ordinance, 1971 in section 9‑A, for the words "Assistant
Commissioner" the words "Assistant District Administrative
Officer" shall be substituted.
